0022600191.text: The Cavaliers (5-4, 4-1 at home) host the Knicks (4-4) in Cleveland's 10th game of the 2026-27 season. Cleveland sits 2nd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and 6th in the East, on a one-game winning streak, while New York is 4th in the Atlantic, 3 games back, and 7th in the East, on a two-game winning streak. Cleveland is without Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), and Sam Merrill (elbow), and New York is without Josh Hart (ankle), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The Cavaliers lost 1-2 to the Knicks in the 2025-26 regular season and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, and their most recent meeting, a 130-93 loss in Cleveland on May 25, 2026, came in that playoff series.
